title: [Master]-Production Order - WIP shows different WIP depending on Starting Date after revaluing reversed consumption
summary: The Inventory Valuation - WIP report now shows the same WIP value whatever Starting Date is used, after reversed consumption has been revalued. A test covers the scenario.
key_points: Fixed the WIP calculation in report 5802 Inventory Valuation - WIP
Handles consumption that was reversed and then revalued
WIP value no longer depends on the Starting Date used
Test added in SCM Inventory Reports III
